<span id="supabase"></span>

## Built with Supabase

I was so excited to join the Supabase team, I designed and built two mobile-responsive Next.js applications with backends powered by Supabase to teach myself about Supabase features. Each application is fully 
supported by documentation I also designed, written in MDX — the same framework used by Supabase to build docs.

### CareerChive

CareerChive is styled with Tailwind CSS and along with a backend and cron jobs powered by Supabase, features:

- Attachment storage powered by Cloudflare R2. Password protection with built-in login attempt limiting.
- Advanced search functionality with embedded AI assistant powered by Gemini.
- Docs in MDX with Gemini chatbot, API reference implemented with Scalar. 

::: {.panel-tabset}

# Archive

::: {.callout}
The below embedded demo iframes are interactive mockups, and are not connected to a live backend deployment.

<!-- For each organization you track with CareerChive, you can auto-generate new daily entries for you to fill in, or use the integrated MCP server to assist you with populating your daily entries. Each day allows you to:  -->


For each organization you track with CareerChive, you can auto-generate new daily entries for you to fill in. Each day allows you to:

- Track attendance and reasons for being absent.
- Log completed work and supporting artifacts by each individual item via drag-and-drop editors.
- Enter rich text notes and comments.
- Rate how you felt that day at work. 😠 🙁 😐 🙂 😄

::: {.iframe url="https://careerchive-demo.vercel.app/?org=current&iso=2026-10-21" title="A Sample Daily Log in CareerChive" zoom="50%" new-window="false"}
:::

After you've entered some daily logs, you can then glean insights about your logging habits, attendance, work you've completed, and mood ratings over time...

::: {.iframe url="https://careerchive-demo.vercel.app/overview?org=current&period=week&view=2026-10-18" title="Sample Overview Analytics in CareerChive" zoom="50%" new-window="false"}
:::

... and search your daily logs by keyword and ask the assistant ChiveBot for information about your logs:

::: {.iframe url="https://careerchive-demo.vercel.app/search?input=search" title="Sample Search in CareerChive" zoom="50%" new-window="false"}
:::

### y2k Guestbook

The y2k Guestbook is styled with Tailwind CSS and along with a backend powered by Supabase, features:

- Admin functionality for comment management and customization, dashboard gated via Google OAuth 2.0.
- Built-in rate limiting and profanity filtering, and admin notifications powered by Supabase Edge Functions.
- Docs in MDX with Gemini chatbot, API reference implemented with Scalar. 

::: {.panel-tabset}
